authorInstruction.title: FREEZE AUTHOR DECISIONS AND FOCAL CHARACTERIZATION OF NORMATIVE DIMENSION TEXT
authorInstruction.authorizes: recording DQ-E2-1 to DQ-E2-11 and one focal characterization of the dimension-value orientation (DQ-E2-6); documentation only

phaseState: PREPARED — AUTHOR DECISIONS FROZEN — IMPLEMENTATION NOT AUTHORIZED

DQ-E2-1.decision: β — COMPOSITION OF EXISTING OUTPUT TYPES — AUTHOR APPROVED FOR E2 DESIGN
DQ-E2-1.escalation: new GeoElement type or XML element type

DQ-E2-2.decision: Offset mandatory; Overshoot and Gap optional, 0 when omitted; no hidden viewport-, DPI-, unit- or length-dependent default

DQ-E2-3.numericValue: model-unit measure, independent of constructionUnit, presentationUnit, drawingScale, viewport, zoom, DPI
DQ-E2-3.displayedValue: format(display(L)) + suffix(effP); display(L) = L * metresPerUnit(effC) / metresPerUnit(effP); UNSPECIFIED_MODEL_UNIT -> format(L), no suffix
constraints: no UnitState read in geometric compute()
no presentation string parsed back into geometry

DQ-E2-4.decision: B1 — PIN THE SIDE / ORIENTATION CHOICE EXPLICITLY
DQ-E2-4.preparationResolution: side = sign(Offset) relative to n = rot90 of the ordered pair A -> B (AlignedDimension) or of getDirection / vector coordinates (LinearDimension); input order and Offset are explicit serialized command inputs; no extra input; the tool fixes the sign once from the placement click

DQ-E2-5.forbidden: getDirectionInD3 as semantic authority; any F1 dependency

DQ-E2-6.decision: NORMATIVE-STYLE ALIGNED DIMENSION VALUE — AUTHOR REQUIREMENT — IMPLEMENTATION SEAM TO BE CHARACTERIZED
requirements: not crossed by the dimension or extension lines
follows the dimension figure, not screen axes
zoom, DPI and viewport are not semantic authority
DQ-E2-6.focalResult: ALIGNED NORMATIVE-STYLE TEXT — FEASIBLE WITH β (C4 bounded drawable seam)

DQ-E2-7.decision: canonical AlignedDimension and LinearDimension; Spanish aliases CotaAlineada and CotaLineal
DQ-E2-7.userMacros: never silently renamed, deleted, migrated or reinterpreted
DQ-E2-7.resolves: native-naming side of OBS-R6PLUS-E2-LEGACY-DIMENSION-MACRO-NAME-COLLISION; coexistence still validated in E2

DQ-E2-8.escalation: new GeoElement, new XML element type or materially new global serialization semantics -> STOP, request GLOBAL_IMPACT review

DQ-E2-9.latex: PSTricks, PGF/TikZ, Asymptote preserve arrows, text positioning and orientation through a bounded GeoCeDG export adaptation; no silent loss
DQ-E2-9.dxf: no DIMENSION entity in E2; segment subset recorded as a durable E2 export limitation; no claim of full DXF dimension semantics

DQ-E2-10.pins: current-base counts only (125 actions at the base)

DQ-E2-11.offset: from the placement click, converted at once into the explicit model-space Offset
DQ-E2-11.toolCapture: once at creation; physical unit + drawingScale may derive paper magnitudes; UNSPECIFIED_MODEL_UNIT never pretends a millimetre relation; view fallback materialized at once
DQ-E2-11.afterCreation: no live viewport, DPI, drawingScale or geometric UnitState dependency
